name: LOOM-8
author: Charles Vestal
description: LOOM-8 turns the M-VAVE FM-1 into a pocket groovebox. Eight tracks play on eleven engines (seven synths, a sample player, a break slicer, a drum kit and MIDI out), with a 64-step sequencer, step tricks and parameter locks. Weave two patterns into a third, let the conductor move the song through a progression, and play throws while it runs. Two send effects, a mixer, scenes and a song round it out. MIDI goes over USB, Bluetooth and the TRS jack, and a USB keyboard or synth plugs in through a powered hub.
